title: Contextual error-targeted ensemble sampler for quantization calibration micro-bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce reproducible, per-domain calibration micro-bundles for FP8 and INT8 quantization validation of production prompts. Unlike the existing reservoir/stratified samplers, this ticket defines an ensemble sampler that blends: 1) semantic clustering to ensure topical coverage, 2) temporal recency weighting to capture drift, and 3) error-targeted oversampling based on model-annotated disagreement and prior quantization regressions. Packs should be small (2k-10k prompts depending on domain traffic) and include provenance metadata, reproducible sampling seeds, and privacy-hardened payloads suitable for internal eval and third-party auditors.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CLI tool (packgen) can produce a per-domain micro-bundle from request logs using configured sampler weights; 2) Pack schema includes provenance, sample_seed, token_length_histogram, redaction_summary, and domain tags; 3) End-to-end FP8 and INT8 calibration runs using these packs reproduce prior baseline within ±1.5% on the primary accuracy metric (semantic-similarity drop) and do not regress on regression suite; 4) Packs include deterministic holdout (10%) for validation and an embargoed test set for final accuracy gate; 5) Sampling reports and artifacts are pushed to Datasets Drive folder and linked from the ticket; 6) Unit and integration tests added for sampler components and CLI.
tasks: Design pack schema and redaction rules (privacy team review)
Implement semantic clustering stage (embedding+KMeans with dynamic k)
Implement temporal recency weighting and decay schedule
Implement error-targeted scorer using model discrepancy signals and past quantization deltas
Combine stages into ensemble weighting with configurable knobs
Build packgen CLI with reproducible seed, logging, and output manifest
Create automated evaluation harness to run FP8/INT8 calibration and generate accuracy reports
Smoke test on 3 verticals (search-assist, helpdesk, finance) and push artifacts
Document sampling strategy, decisions, and runbook in Confluence
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: oversampling rare error cases could bias calibration and degrade generalization. Mitigation: enforce max error-oversample cap (e.g., 25% of pack) and maintain stratified random baseline cohort. Risk: privacy-sensitive tokens included. Mitigation: redaction rules + differential privacy check prior to pack release. Risk: heavy clustering compute cost. Mitigation: use approximate nearest neighbors and incremental clustering checkpointing.
design_decisions:
- Use semantic embeddings (unified embedding model) for initial clustering to avoid per-model tokenization variance.
- Dynamic cluster count chosen by silhouette heuristic clipped per-domain to avoid fragmentation.
- Temporal decay uses exponential half-life default 30 days but configurable per-domain.
- Error-targeted score derived from ensemble disagreement across three model variants (fp32 reference, int8 precursor, fp8 precursor) and past quant-regression log entries.
- Token-length buckets: [0-32,33-128,129-512,513+] enforced to maintain generation-conditioned calibration fidelity.
implementation_notes:
- packgen will accept a domain tag and date range and produce: pack.tar.gz, manifest.json, metadata.txt.
- Metadata fields: sample_seed, sampler_weights, earliest_ts, latest_ts, total_candidates, final_count, holdout_seed, redaction_hash.
- Use Faiss for ANN neighbor queries, but provide fallback to HNSW for smaller domains.
- Provide a fast path to produce "mini debug packs" (250 samples) for engineers to iterate quickly.
- Store packs in Drive under /Redwood/Calibration/Packs/{domain}/{YYYYMMDD}/pack-{seed}.tar.gz and register dataset link in our internal datasets catalog (dataset-id to be returned by packgen).
